description: Add a channel alerts can be sent to, then name its id in create_alert or update_alert channelIds. kind "slack": channelId and channelName from list_slack_channels (a private channel needs the bot invited first). kind "webhook": url, optional label and headers; the signing secret comes back once, in this answer. Email lists are made in the dashboard or with POST /v1/channels, which send each address its confirmation link. events: attention events to receive here (mention.spike, sentiment.negative_spike, keyword.noisy, channel.failing; on a webhook also the account events), on top of what rules send.

channelId.description: slack: the channel id (C...) from list_slack_channels.

channelName.description: slack: the channel name, for the label.

events.description: Events to receive here on top of rules. Omit for none.

headers.description: webhook: extra request headers, for your own auth.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. A unique value (a UUID) for this call: 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters, no spaces. Calling again with the same key and the same input within 24 hours returns the first result instead of doing it twice.

label.description: webhook: a name; the URL host when omitted.

url.description: webhook: where the signed POSTs go.
